angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 2,856,544 km at 41.13 pc = 0.93 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 95294: distance 41.135 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.008), at which the luminosity and radius hold (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 41.135 +/- 0.329 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 23.3612 +/- 0.2744 mas (same row, RUWE 2.61), 85.1 standard errors, is not used
radiusSource: Radius 4.106 solar radii from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 95294: radius 4.106 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 28.998 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.12) and temperature (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 2,856,544 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 6615 +/- 451 K from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 95294: effective temperature 6615 +/- 451 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.171) (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 95294: effective temperature 6615 +/- 451 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.171) (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433)
spectralTypeSource: SIMBAD, * bet02 Sgr: spectral type F2/3V (1978MSS...C02....0H)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: SIMBAD, * bet02 Sgr: projected rotation speed 112 km/s, the measurement SIMBAD prefers (2005yCat.3244....0G)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.

surfaceGravitySource: log g 3.55 from 2003A&A...398.1121E; the 1 published value span log g 3.55 to 3.55, across which the limb law changes by at most 0.0% of the centre brightness (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2003A%26A...398.1121E)
